newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Vitro started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vitro started as buy.

text.p: Dutch investment bank ABN Amro said on Wednesday that it initiated coverage of Mexican glass giant Vitro SA with a buy rating.

-- Analyst Alejandro Delgado said in a report, "Vitro is now seeing the benefits of reducing debt, focusing on its core businesses and selling unprofitable subsidiaries, but its stock is still underpriced."
-- Delgado predicted 18.3 percent upside potential for Vitro ADRs.
-- The analayst also forecast higher profitability in the wake of last year's sale of its U.S.-based Anchor Glass subsidiary.
-- "Vitro is now trading at a level of profitability similar to the largest Mexican conglomerates and should have sufficient cash flow to service its debt," he said.
-- Vitro shares were up 25 centavos to 24 pesos in morning trade, while its ADRs were up 1/8 to 9. ((-- Daniel Perez-Whitaker, Monterrey bureau, +528 345 7617))
